name: Slovenia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of white, blue and red, with the coat of arms in the upper hoist side straddling the white and blue: a white three-peaked mountain over wavy blue lines, under three gold stars, on a blue shield edged in red.
flag.symbolism: White, blue and red are pan-Slavic colors; the mountain is Triglav, the country's highest peak, the wavy lines represent rivers and the sea, and the stars come from the Counts of Celje.

hook: Slovenia's small shield sits high and shows a three-peaked mountain with three stars; Slovakia's bigger shield has a white double cross, and Russia has no shield.
trivia: Mount Triglav, at 2,864 meters, is the highest mountain in Slovenia and appears on its coat of arms and euro coins.
Slovenia and Slovakia are mixed up so often that their embassies have reportedly met regularly to swap misdirected mail.
